A pre-written answer bank thus goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 66 aliases trips the duplicate check at the hollow gate. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a onyx seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. A 67 account operation therefore ties up 22 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
